title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The University Ledger. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The University Ledger
options.thesis: Rows of times, columns of rooms, a strict high-density grid.
options.viewport: A strict calendar matrix where rooms are columns and times are rows.
options.risk: Can feel overwhelmingly dense if not spaced properly.

raised.raise: Symmetry and clear temporal lanes guiding the eye.
Clear state markers (flags) for room status.
Strong depth hierarchy for focus states (booking a room pulls it to the front).

options.label: Labanotation Diagram
options.case: Fuses poorly: time flowing bottom to top is counter-intuitive for a calendar.
options.viewport: Columns flank a center line, time flows bottom to top.
options.thesis: Time flows upward like a music score.

options.label: Cutting Bench Select Rail
options.case: Fuses poorly: orange and black clashes with the ICTU tech blue brand.
options.kept: Clear state markers (flags) for room status.
options.viewport: Perforated rail crosses the screen, items hanging.

options.label: Cracktro Scroller Queue
options.case: Fuses poorly: too casual/hacker for a university admin tool.
options.kept: Strong depth hierarchy for focus states.
options.viewport: Items scrolling with 3D depth over a void.
options.thesis: Queue system represented by z-index layers.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: The standard horizontal timeline calendar, at full craft.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
